title: Transport-Free Lower Bounds for Ollivier--Ricci Curvature in Higher-Order Networks: Scope, Tightness, and Computational Applications
abstract: arXiv:2405.13302v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study how the Bauer--Jost--Liu curvature bound applies to hypergraph Ollivier--Ricci curvature (ORC) and how its accuracy depends on local mass and geometry. An explicit weighted-graph representation shows how the graph theorem applies. A transport construction transfers the bounds to monotone pairwise hyperedge aggregations. We analyze endpoint cancellation under laziness, quantify the exact improvement over the earlier mixture bound, and characterize the extremal geometry at fixed endpoint and overlap statistics. Further results quantify worst-case slack, stability, and exactness on isolated hyperedges. A capacity-constrained short-detour refinement uses additional geometric information and improves monotonically as the query budget increases. As a computational application, a threshold cascade preserves exact transport decisions. Numerical verification and public-hypergraph experiments examine tightness, walk dependence,

translated_title: 高阶网络中Ollivier–Ricci曲率的无传输下界：适用范围、紧致性与计算应用
translated_abstract: 我们研究Bauer–Jost–Liu曲率界如何应用于超图Ollivier–Ricci曲率（ORC），以及其精度如何依赖于局部质量和几何结构。我们给出了一个显式的加权图表示，说明图定理如何适用于超图情形；并通过一个传输构造将该界推广到单调成对超边聚合。我们分析了惰性条件下的端点抵消现象，量化了相对于早期混合界的精确改进幅度，并刻画了在固定端点和重叠统计量下的极值几何。进一步的结果量化了最坏情况下的松弛度、稳定性以及孤立超边上的精确性。一种容量受限的短绕行精化方法利用额外的几何信息，并随着查询预算的增加而单调改进。作为计算应用，阈值级联方法能够保留精确的传输决策。数值验证和公开超图实验检验了界的紧致性和对游走的依赖性。
tldr: 本文将Bauer–Jost–Liu曲率界推广至超图Ollivier–Ricci曲率，建立了无需最优传输计算的下界，刻画了其适用范围、紧致性与极值几何，并给出了高效的计算应用。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the Bauer–Jost–Liu curvature bound to hypergraph Ollivier–Ricci curvature, establishing transport-free lower bounds with characterized scope, tightness, and extremal geometry, along with efficient computational applications.
